image_brief: anonymous creator making a Pixar-quality animated film alone on a laptop with free AI tools in two hours
caption:
An anonymous X user just made a full AI animation in 2 hours that hit 500K views

On September 26, an anonymous creator posted a finished animated short that took two hours to make from scratch. They got a script from Pocket FM, a podcast app, fed it into Seedance 2.5, an AI video generator, and walked away with a finished film. They never touched a drawing tool. The short got 500.9K views and 811 people quoted it. If you're paying tuition to study animation right now, an anonymous guy on the internet just did your four-year degree before dinner.

When one person with no studio and free AI tools can get half a million views overnight, the filmmaking industry has a real problem. 811 people quoted it the same night.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: AngryTomtweets on X
